evidence: The new guard in migrate_cards.go runs shapeOf(newBlock + body) after the stopped-run block is substituted, so it covers both fresh and stopped pages.
On refusal it calls refuse and continues before g.claimed or moved.Address are set, so the memory is not claimed and nothing is written. This matches the commit's claim.

I found no regression on previously valid input from the diff alone. The guard assumes shapeOf returns a block in the same form as newBlock, and the diff does not show shapeOf; the added tests would fail if that form differed.
Both new tests cover the refused case and the other-pages-migrated case, including the unchanged refused page and its unchanged entry.
